correctness.rationale: Normality of multiplication by z^m gives K=P M Q M* P-P M* Q M P, with this sign for S*S-SS*. At angular index k, Q contributes only the two normalized input harmonics of indices k-m and k+m; subtracting the local harmonic projection gives the signed difference of their rank-one forms. Conjugation exchanges the two signs at opposite indices, and the two projected generators coincide at zero. For k>=m the first generator is already harmonic before projection, and the remaining squared norm is b_k. The moment quotient r_m(k)=h_{k+m}/h_k is strictly increasing by its product of increasing consecutive ratios. For 1<=k<m the radial exponents k, 2m-k, 2m+k are distinct on a measure with full radial support; their projected vectors have strictly positive Gram determinant. The signed block has trace A_k-B_k and determinant G_k^2-A_k B_k, yielding the claimed opposite-sign roots and infinite kernel. The product expansion to second order gives b_k~m^2(alpha+1)k^(-2); counting the two tails gives the stated signed counts and s_n, compactness, sharp p>1/2 and trace zero. Summing r_m(k+m)-r_m(k) telescopes; adding twice the central discriminant roots yields the exact trace norm. For alpha=0, m=2, exact h_j=1/(j+1) gives the displayed central roots and decreasing b_k=4/((k+3)(k+5)), so the central operator norm really exceeds the whole tail. Independent finite check: 924 angular cases, including nonintegral weights, computing S*S and SS* as successive exact compressed multiplications; python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce_records_1_to_4.py. This corroborates block identities; the analytic argument proves the infinite spectrum. The frozen checker and verification record were inspected, not executed or counted as independent evidence.
